content:
**Shotgun Champ**, formerly **Master Shotgunner**, is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increased damage per weapon projectile, if enemy is crippled.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 3 | +10% damage to crippled targets per projectile your weapon fires. | 001A2DE1 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Master Shotgunner." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to shotguns.

 Fat Man with MIRV launcher modification does not benefit from the perk. [verified]
